title: 第88章 要不要来姐姐这？

第88章 要不要来姐姐这？-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

许辰无奈摇头，得了，还真有人信，有人信也就罢了，还有人借坡继续吹牛，和自己一起饮酒？

在酒店将两人的衣服丢下楼，并且果断提出分手，看似她很坚强，其实只有她自己知道，当时她的浑身都在颤抖，她是用了最大的克制力才忍住没在两人面前哭出来。

简莫凡在一旁倒是很淡定的坐着，结果季思悦递过来的咖啡，挥手示意她出去。

她没有排斥的动作，让苏晚歌信心大增，长着嘴，正想要要开口说话，却突然被人拉了过去。

“不错。是我。我曾经说过的。伤害你的人。我一个也不会放过。宛贵人已经被我打入冷宫。现在就轮到她了。看到这一幕。你是不是觉得有些熟悉呢。”奕少卿问道。

自己去掉了金属手臂的约束，绝对算得上是一名自由人，当然，还有最重要的一点。

他的修为早在之前就到达了突破的边缘，只是限于大乘帝境被麟天帝占据，所以一直不能突破，如今麟天帝已死，大乘帝境的位置空了出来，许辰积压的修为，顿时突破。

简莫凡觉得颜沐沐的质问实在是有些肤浅了，他对她是怎样的她自己难道不清楚吗？为何还要这样问，他现在真是懒得回答这个问题。

“住手。”一声清冷的声音惊了所有人，那卖馒头的也真的住了手，大家不约而同的向这边望了过来。栖蝶步履缓慢，人们见她走了过来，都纷纷让开了路，似乎她本就是应该凌驾于众人之上的。

有阿丑在，他可以排查附近所有的危险，除非是他主动去招惹的，基本上是不可能碰到危险的，因此，他就不是在冒险，那他要和这个阵法的王八蛋设计者玩到底也变得很正常的。

“这样不好吧，人家有自己的安排。”花落雨倒是不介意在众人面前练习，她早就习惯了被人关注的场面，不要这个百花林，就是在帝国的皇宫表演，她都一样淡定。

Xu Chen shook his head helplessly, come on, some people really believe it, that's fine with some people believing it, but there are still people who use Po to continue to brag and drink with him?

Throwing their clothes downstairs in the hotel and decisively breaking up, she seemed to be very strong, but in fact only she knew that her whole body was shaking at the time, and she used the utmost restraint to hold back from crying in front of the two of them.

Jian Mofan sat calmly aside, but Ji Siyue handed over the coffee and waved her out.

Her lack of rejection greatly boosted Su Wange's confidence. He opened his mouth and was about to speak when he was suddenly pulled over.

"That's right. It's me. I've said it before. I won't let go of anyone who hurts you. Wan Gui has been relegated to the cold palace by me. Now it's her turn. Seeing this scene, do you feel familiar?" Yi Shaoqing asked.

Having removed the restraints of the metal arm, he is definitely a free man. Of course, the most important thing is.

His cultivation level had reached the edge of breakthrough long ago, but it was limited to the Mahayana Emperor realm being occupied by Emperor Lintian, so he could not break through. Now that Emperor Lintian is dead, the position of Mahayana Emperor realm has been vacated, and Xu Chen's accumulated cultivation level has suddenly broken through.

Jian Mofan felt that Yan Mumu's questioning was a bit superficial. Didn't she know what he was like to her?Why do you still ask this? He is really too lazy to answer this question now.

"Stop." A cold voice startled everyone, and the bun seller really stopped. Everyone looked over here in unison.Qi Die walked slowly, and when people saw her approaching, they all moved out of the way. It seemed that she was supposed to be above everyone else.

With A Chou here, he can detect all nearby dangers. Unless he takes the initiative to provoke them, it is basically impossible to encounter danger. Therefore, he is not taking risks, so it is normal for him to play with the bastard designer of this formation to the end.

"Isn't this good? People have their own arrangements." Hua Luoyu doesn't mind practicing in front of everyone. She has long been used to the scene of being noticed. Not in this Baihua Forest, even if she is performing in the imperial palace, she will be just as calm.
